metadata.title: आदिवासी की ज़मीन के लिए साम-दाम-दंड-भेद | Adivasis fight to save their land | Pulin Bihari Baske
metadata.description:
This interview focuses on the current situation surrounding the Deocha-Pachami coal project in Birbhum district of West Bengal, which is being touted as one of India's largest coal mining projects. The project is expected to displace around 20,000 to 25,000 people, a significant portion of whom belong to tribal communities.

To discuss this sensitive issue, the interview features Puline Bihari Baske, a prominent tribal leader and former Member of Parliament from West Bengal.
